text:
Alex Gehaz Malasusa succeeded Stephen Moshi (whom you wrote as "Stefano Moshi") as presiding bishop of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in Tanzania in 2017, as far as I know. The team note says Samson Mushemba succeeded Moshi, which I can't verify and which conflicts with what I know. If the note reflects a later leadership change, it would supersede my answer, but I have no source to confirm it.

CONFIDENCE: 55
